snippet.title: S.T.A.R.W.I.E.L.D | Launch Trailer | PC |
snippet.description:
My game releases on August 1st on Steam. Add it to your wishlist! 🌟🗓️✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843400

S.T.A.R.W.I.E.L.D is an action RPG in an open world developed by a indie developer. Travel across the planet's surface on a bike, complete quests, and fight monsters. 🚀🛵⚔️

The developer's social media: 
https://www.artstation.com/jessystorm
https://www.twitch.tv/jessystorm
https://discord.com/invite/9CkAnUjaNs
